name: taf.sh
description: Independent software studio of Tashif Ahmad Khan. Tools register on document.modelContext in a live tab. They are not HTTP APIs.

tools.name: get_studio_overview
tools.description: Overview of taf.sh, Tashif Ahmad Khan, and the public pages on this site.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Get one taf.sh service by id: product, ai, messaging, or web.

id.description: Service id: product, ai, messaging, web

tools.name: list_work
tools.description: List studio products, team work, and tools shown on taf.sh.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one product or case study by name or path, such as TalentSync or /products/rah-clinic.

tools.name: get_about
tools.description: Facts about Tashif Ahmad Khan and taf.sh.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: How to reach Tashif. Does not send mail.

tools.name: copy_studio_email
tools.description: Copy me@taf.sh to the clipboard. Does not send mail.

tools.name: start_contact
tools.description: Draft a project brief to me@taf.sh. Fills the on-page form when present, opens the visitor's mail app, and returns the full draft. Does not send until a human hits Send or the agent sends from the user's mailbox after they confirm.

brief.description: What they are building, timing, and what is in the way. At least 20 characters.
